Run A:

1. **Route the set.** There are two PR tokens and the harness is pi, so the run follows the set-routing row. I read `reference/batch.md`.
2. **Admit the set.** Admission passes:
   - There is no positional issue reference.
   - The two bare numbers do not duplicate each other.
   - Neither token is a URL that could point to another repository.
   - The set holds 2 PRs, within the cap of 4 from `parallel.maxTasks`.
   - The harness is pi.
   
   This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line prints.
3. **Mint the run folder.** I mint one parent `RUN_DIR` (a `gate.` folder) from the session checkout through `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. Children do not mint their own.
4. **Gather each PR.** I run one metadata read per token, in typed order, with each token unchanged:
   - `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`
   - The same command with `101` as the token.
5. **Read the viewer once each.**
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.
6. **Run the ticket display reads.** `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`. Then I read the overrides paths in search order:
   - `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`
   
   None carries a tracker override.
7. **Resolve each ticket.**
   - #112 has closing issue #22 in acme/widgets, which matches origin.
   - #101 has no closing issue. Its branch `gh-45-retry` yields #45 in origin.
8. **Write the list.** The list goes in the reply that carries the first provisioning call. It has no marker and does not wait.

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - routes all settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raises the default retry timeout for slow requests
---
Paired call: `git fetch origin`

**Next step:** serial provisioning in the parent, PR #112 first and then #101. The provisioning list check is skipped because the list is already in view.

```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests

git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

1. **Run the single-PR preamble.** There is one typed token and Section A is already in context, so I run the preamble. The view's `url` sets the base repository to acme/gadgets. Later number-only calls carry `-R acme/gadgets`.
2. **Skip the origin lookup.** `git remote get-url origin` is not run. The base repository from the view's url replaces checkout origin for the issue label.
3. **Find no overrides.** None of the three overrides files exists, so Linear lookups would be allowed. They are not needed, because the closing issue #45 is in acme/gadgets, which matches the base repository.
4. **Set the reason line.** Robin is the author and the pending User request is for alex, so the entry reads "requested from you".

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - adds a CSV export button to the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

I keep that run list result in context.

**Next step:** Progress tracking, in this order:
1. Mint the run folder.
2. Initialize the continuation record.
3. Initialize `plan_tracker` with `gather, provision, verify`.

Gather then resumes at the GraphQL call. It does not rerun the preamble or the first run list.
